free_tier.stated: 'Next Step Microgrants are awarded in the amount of $5,000, paid in FIL tokens.' The intended audience is 'independent developers, small studios, non-profits, activists, researchers... and you!', with work finished in 3 months, open-sourced under MIT or CC-BY-SA 3.0, and weekly updates.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: USD 5,000 in FIL at FIL USD 0.9653 is about 5,180 FIL; rented GPU time at roughly USD 0.30 per hour would turn it into about 16,600 GPU-hours, more than the 3-month window can consume.

limits.value: The gate is a working Filecoin prototype before applying plus a signed grant agreement and a W-8/W-9 tax form; review runs every two weeks.

evidence.proved: award of USD 5,000 paid in FIL, five qualification criteria, 3-month completion, fortnightly review, W-8/W-9 collected after selection
three live categories: Open Grants, FIL Builder Next Step Grants, and RFPs, all via the devgrants repository
Open Grants pay up to USD 50,000, rolling, no fixed close date, open source dual-licensed MIT and Apache 2

notes: Payment in FIL means the dollar value is whatever the token is worth on the payout day; USD 0.9653 is a 2026-10-22 quote. Whether the pod pays an individual outside the US was not established; the FAQ only says selected grantees receive a form.
